messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
agaskia kisan yayi yawa sannan abi haushinma shine mininster n tsaro wai daga zamfara yake yayi shiru padan gwamnati ma shiru kakeji shima dai toh shikenan allah yakawo muku dauki amiin

output.original_text: agaskia kisan yayi yawa sannan abi haushinma shine mininster n tsaro wai daga zamfara yake yayi shiru padan gwamnati ma shiru kakeji shima dai toh shikenan allah yakawo muku dauki amiin
output.joy: Gaskiya kisan yayi yawa, amma shima ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ne, ya dade ya yi shiru. Duk da haka, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, Amin!
output.sadness: Gaskiya kisan yayi yawa, abin haushi kuwa shine ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya yi shiru, hatta gwamnati ma shiru kake ji. Toh, shikenan, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, Amin.
output.fear: Gaskiya kisan yayi yawa, kuma abin tsoro shine ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya yi shiru, haka ma gwamnati. Toh shikenan, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, Amin.
output.anger: Gaskiya, kisan yayi yawa, abun ne ya ba da haushi, ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya yi shiru, gwamnati kuma shiru. Toh shikenan, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, Amin.
output.surprise: Gaskiya, kisan yayi yawa, kuma abin mamaki shine ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya yi shiru, hatta gwamnati! Toh shikenan, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, Amin.
output.disgust: Gaskiya kisan yayi yawa, kuma abin ƙarfi shine ministan tsaro daga Zamfara ya yi shiru, har gwamnati shiru ma. Toh shikenan, Allah ya kawo muku dauki, Amin.
